private static boolean isParameterSeparator(final char c){
    // Common separators: whitespace, punctuation, and delimiters
    return Character.isWhitespace(c) ||
           c == ',' || c == ';' || c == ':' ||
           c == '(' || c == ')' || c == '[' || c == ']' ||
           c == '{' || c == '}' || c == '<' || c == '>' ||
           c == '/' || c == '\\' || c == '|' ||
           c == '"' || c == '\'' || c == '`' ||
           c == '.' || c == '!' || c == '?' ||
           c == '~' || c == '@' || c == '#' ||
           c == '$' || c == '%' || c == '^' ||
           c == '&' || c == '*' || c == '+' ||
           c == '-' || c == '=' || c == '_';
}
